title: Find the Right Solution for Your Business
description: Answer three quick questions and get a solution matched to your goals, stage, and budget.

need.question: What would you like to create or improve?
need.hint: Choose the closest match — we'll tailor the rest.

goal.question: What outcome matters most right now?
goal.hint: Pick the outcome you care about most.

stage.question: Where are you in your business journey?
stage.hint: This only adjusts the estimated timeline.

stepDescriptions.goalHint: Choose the goal that matches your current priority.
stepDescriptions.stageHintShort: Choose the stage that describes your business today.
stepDescriptions.stageHintLong: Choose the stage that describes your business today — we'll match the recommendation to it.

improve-seo.label: Improve SEO Visibility
improve-seo.description: Rank higher for the searches that matter

business-website.insight: Great choice. A professional website can help establish trust, explain your services clearly and turn visitors into inquiries.

ecommerce.insight: Selling online works best with a frictionless path from product to checkout — that's the thread running through this build.

hospital-software.insight: Healthcare platforms succeed on clarity — clean records, fast scheduling, and access that matches each role.

school-erp.insight: A good school platform gives every group — admin, teachers, parents — exactly the view they need, nothing more.

saas-product.insight: Launching a platform is about proving the core loop first, then layering in billing and scale once it's working.

crm.insight: A CRM only earns its keep if the team actually uses it — so this build centers a clean, searchable customer record.

branding.insight: A strong identity is the fastest way to look established — this path builds a system you can reuse everywhere.

digital-marketing.insight: Visibility compounds — the earlier tracking and content are in place, the faster the rest of this pays off.

focusByGoal.generate-leads: Emphasize lead-capture forms and calls to action throughout the build.
focusByGoal.sell-online: Prioritize a frictionless checkout and payment experience.
focusByGoal.automate-operations: Focus on workflows that remove manual, repetitive work first.
focusByGoal.launch-mvp: Trim scope to the smallest version that proves the concept.
focusByGoal.improve-brand: Lead with visual identity and consistency across every touchpoint.
focusByGoal.manage-customers: Center the build around a clear, searchable customer record.
focusByGoal.improve-seo: Prioritize on-page structure and content that ranks.
focusByGoal.scale-product: Focus on the systems and performance headroom growth needs next.
